items.title: Coproducts, limits, and the functor F on SR(C) and SR(C,X)
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file hypercovering.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Verify the finitary completeness of the category SR(C) of families of objects and its pointed variant SR(C,X): coproducts are disjoint unions of index sets with F commuting; limits are computed on sections via Mor({U},K) = F(K)(U) and the sectionwise computation of limits of presheaves; give the explicit fibred products {U_i x_{V} W_k} over matching indices, products {U_i x V_j}, equalizers Eq(f_i,f'_i) over matching indices, and final object {X}; for SR(C,X) deduce the statements from SR(C/X) = SR(C,X) and PSh(C/X) = PSh(C)/h_X (chaotic topology), and re-verify coproducts, the final object {X->X}, and fibred products directly, concluding finite limits exist by categories-lemma-finite-limits-exist.
